title: Understanding Linear Regression
content: Today I reviewed the mathematical foundation of linear regression and how ordinary least squares minimizes prediction error. Gradient descent helps optimize model parameters efficiently.

title: Bias Variance Tradeoff
content: Studied how model complexity affects underfitting and overfitting. Cross-validation provides a practical way to estimate generalization performance.

title: Random Forest Ensembles
content: Random forests combine multiple decision trees trained on different subsets of data. This reduces overfitting and improves prediction stability.

title: Support Vector Machines
content: Learned how support vector machines use hyperplanes and kernels to separate complex datasets. The maximum-margin principle improves classification robustness.

title: Clustering with K-Means
content: Implemented K-Means clustering and explored how the elbow method helps determine the optimal number of clusters.

title: Feature Engineering Techniques
content: Studied feature scaling, encoding categorical variables, and handling missing values. Better features often improve model performance more than algorithm changes.

title: Backpropagation Fundamentals
content: Worked through the mathematics of backpropagation and gradient computation. Understanding gradient flow clarified how neural networks learn.

title: Activation Functions
content: Compared ReLU, Sigmoid, and Tanh activation functions. ReLU remains popular because it helps mitigate vanishing gradients.

title: Convolutional Neural Networks
content: Built a simple CNN and explored convolutional filters, pooling layers, and feature extraction for image classification.

title: Reducing Overfitting
content: Applied dropout and regularization techniques to improve generalization performance in deep neural networks.

title: Recurrent Neural Networks
content: Studied how recurrent neural networks process sequential information using hidden states across time steps.

title: LSTM Networks
content: Learned how LSTMs solve long-term dependency issues through forget, input, and output gates.

title: Transformer Architecture
content: Studied self-attention mechanisms and parallel sequence processing. Transformers form the foundation of modern language models.

title: Positional Encoding
content: Explored how positional encoding introduces sequence order information into transformer architectures.

title: Prompt Engineering
content: Practiced zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought prompting techniques to improve language model responses.

title: Fine Tuning Strategies
content: Compared full fine-tuning with parameter-efficient approaches such as LoRA for adapting language models.

title: Tokenization Methods
content: Studied Byte Pair Encoding and WordPiece tokenization techniques used by modern language models.

title: Model Alignment
content: Explored hallucination reduction strategies and reinforcement learning from human feedback for language model alignment.

title: Core Concepts of RAG
content: Studied retrieval-augmented generation and how retrieved knowledge improves answer grounding and reduces hallucinations.

title: Vector Databases
content: Explored vector databases and similarity search techniques for storing and retrieving semantic embeddings efficiently.

title: Memory Based Retrieval
content: Studied how structured memories can be embedded and retrieved using semantic similarity search. Retrieved memories provide context for generated answers.

title: Embedding Models
content: Compared embedding models and their impact on semantic retrieval quality. Better embeddings improve search relevance.

title: Semantic Search with pgvector
content: Studied how pgvector stores embeddings and performs cosine similarity search. HNSW indexing improves retrieval performance.

title: Context Assembly for RAG
content: Explored how retrieved memories are assembled into a context block before being sent to Gemini for answer generation.

title: Grounded Response Evaluation
content: Evaluated whether generated responses accurately referenced retrieved memories. Source attribution improves answer transparency.

title: pgvector Integration
content: Integrated pgvector into PostgreSQL and created HNSW indexes for efficient semantic retrieval of learning memories.

title: Gemini RAG Pipeline
content: Implemented a retrieval-augmented generation workflow using semantic search, context assembly, and Gemini 2.5 Flash.

title: Learning Intelligence Architecture
content: Designed a pipeline connecting learning tracks, study logs, memories, embeddings, analytics, and recommendations into a unified learning intelligence platform.
